ui.dialog.no_raw: This is a saved score or a manual example. No OCR log is available for this session.
ui.dialog.cloud_info:
Local recognition needs no API key. Online recognition sends the entire current image to the service below.
A base URL (for example http://127.0.0.1:8317) or /v1 automatically uses /v1/chat/completions. Other full paths are preserved.
The key is kept only for this session; the service may charge a fee. Your score is preserved if the request fails.
The request runs in the background. Results are only applied after preview and confirmation.
ui.dialog.endpoint: API base URL or full endpoint
ui.dialog.repeat_hint:
Use the note numbers shown in the editor (starting at 1). The end note is included.
Set the first-ending start to 0 for no alternate endings. The second ending follows the end note. Nested repeats are not supported.
ui.dialog.wait: Please wait for recognition or sound loading to finish before closing.
